correctness.rationale: An orbit-barycenter PL homeomorphism reduces each geometric fixed locus to a rigorously defined finite clique complex. A standalone exhaustive checker inspects every one of the 392 group elements, validates all exact metric/compatibility computations and free-face collapses, and identifies remaining S0/S1/S2 cores through explicitly checked manifold and graph criteria. The sole identity S3 case is the published theorem, whose metric, hypotheses and proof context were inspected. The Lefschetz character then follows exactly.

value.rationale: The first published seven-by-seven torus-grid Rips three-sphere has a natural full coordinate-dihedral action whose geometric fixed subspaces are not determined by ordinary Betti numbers. Classifying all 392 elements, including empty, disconnected, circle and sphere fixed loci, and obtaining its integral orientation character resolves a natural equivariant question motivated by the source paper, rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
